intro: Lesson 16: The Hijrah: the plan, the cave of Thawr and Abu Bakr as-Siddiq. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: The plot and the plan
points: The Quraysh plotted to kill him (8:30)
Abu Bakr prepared camels and a guide

timeline.label: 3 days
timeline.text: Hide in the cave of Thawr

timeline.label: Food
timeline.text: Asma' bint Abi Bakr brings food

timeline.label: Route
timeline.text: A guide takes a coastal path

passage.title: Qur'an, at-Tawbah 9:40 (translation of the meaning)
paras: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.

keywords.def: the migration from Makkah to Madinah in 622 CE
the mountain cave where they hid for three days
trusting Allah after doing your best

questions.q: Explain how the Hijrah shows planning and trust together.
questions.a: They planned camels, a guide, food and a hiding place, then trusted Allah in the cave (9:40).

questions.q: How long did they hide in the cave?
Make a Hijrah timeline on the pupil PDF (six events), then write in the portal response box how one event shows tawakkul. Start: 'Tawakkul means ... For example, ...'
questions.a: Six events in order; tawakkul explained with the cave or the plan

questions.q: Extend: why is Abu Bakr called as-Siddiq?
questions.a: He always believed the Prophet ﷺ and was truthful.

questions.q: Stretch: why did the Muslims later start their calendar from the Hijrah?
questions.a: It began the first Muslim community and state.

questions.q: Who slept in the Prophet's ﷺ bed?
questions.a: A) Ali. Ali stayed behind; Abu Bakr travelled with the Prophet ﷺ.

questions.q: Think again: is trust enough without a plan?
questions.a: No: plan carefully, then trust Allah.
